learned_card.body: Apply by Fast stage when missingness is visible. inspect: Emit at most two disjoint hypotheses. Record missingness from missing_fraction and longest_missing_run_fraction, and extreme_deviation from local_robust_z_peak, as separate hypotheses when both are present; do not merge a high robust-z peak into a broad low-density or missingness span. If neither mechanism is localized, emit no_actionable_signal. propose: One hypothesis maps to one mechanism family. Bind an intrinsic missingness operator only to a missingness hypothesis, and only when it is not deterministically inert. Bind an intrinsic deviation operator only to an extreme_deviation hypothesis. Do not stack same-family steps, do not propose parameter-only variants, and do not copy a runtime prior. If no legal verifiable binding exists, return an empty candidate set. select: Choose one verified id and record verification actions and scope. Unknown probe direction is not a measured benefit and is not a measured harm. Non-inertness or operator allowance is not sufficient justification. Prefer identity when probes are unknown, when missingness and extreme deviation compete without a disjoint high-confidence localization, or when no candidate uniquely matches the dominant inspect hypothesis with a legal receipt. Select a program only for that unique match. Never use series identity or unverifiable utility.
